title: cost-opt-autotune-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Adds autotune defaults for batching and caching, introduces quantization profile templates, and a unit-economics dashboard integration for runtime recommendations.
description: Motivation: We want to reduce per-token inference cost for common request patterns by automating conservative batching/caching defaults, surfacing quantization profile suggestions, and exposing unit-economics guidance in the Console. This PR integrates autotune defaults into the serving runtime config, adds quantization profile templates for common model families, and wires a preliminary UEcon API endpoint consumed by the Console. Summary of changes: 1) runtime/autotune: introduce 'autotune_defaults' config that applies safe batching and KV-cache policies per model family; 2) runtime/batcher: adapt continuous-batcher to respect per-route latency SLOs when autotune_defaults are enabled; 3) quant/profiles: add profiles for llama2-family, falcon-family, and mosaicml that map to 8-bit/4-bit and mixed-precision suggestions; 4) telemetry/uecon: new /internal/uecon/recommendations endpoint and a small service that computes estimated cost/token and suggests batch size/quant profile; 5) console: hook to display recommendations and a quick-apply button; 6) tests: unit + integration test coverage for autotune defaults and UEcon API. Commits: ["feat(autotune): add autotune_defaults config and apply pipeline","perf(batcher): make batching respect autotune latency SLOs","feat(quant): add quantization profiles for Llama2/Falcon/MosaicML","chore(uecon): add internal uecon service and endpoint","test: add unit and integration tests for autotune & uecon","docs: document autotune defaults and console integration"] Files changed (high-level): ["runtime/autotune/config.go","runtime/batcher/continuous_batcher.go","quant/profiles/profiles.yaml","telemetry/uecon/service.go","telemetry/uecon/handlers.go","console/src/components/UeconRecommendations.tsx","console/src/api/uecon.ts","tests/autotune_test.go","tests/uecon_integration_test.go","docs/engineering/autotune.md","ci/workflows/uecon.yml","Makefile (small change to run new integration tests)"] Testing and CI: CI initially failed on lint and a flaky integration test (uecon_integration_test). Fixes applied: adjusted test timeout and added retry for a transient mock backend in tests. Final CI run: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, e2e smoke). Review timeline and conversation: Diego: "Can we make sure default batch sizes are conservative for sub-50ms SLOs?" Author reply: "Yes — autotune_defaults includes per-slo conservative overrides; added unit tests covering 20ms and 50ms SLOs." Lena: "Quant profiles look good but ensure we don't suggest 4-bit for models with known numerics issues." Author reply: "Added model-family blacklist and a safety gate; console only shows 4-bit as experimental with a confirmation prompt." Samir: "Telemetry: confirm no PII leaves customer VPCs." Author reply: "UEcon service uses aggregated metrics; added note and audit log entry; telemetry schema validated." Approvals and merge: after two rounds of small changes and an SRE sign-off, reviewers approved and the PR was squash-merged. Merge method: squash. Merge commit message: "cost: autotune defaults + quant profiles + uecon tooling — squash-merged" Rollout notes: Gradual rollout gated by feature flag 'autotune_defaults' per-customer; default off for Dedicated customers without explicit opt-in. Monitoring: added alerts for increased latency after applying recommendations and an UEcon regression monitor to catch cost increases > 5% compared to baseline. Related work: References ENG-4213 (autotune design), ENG-4320 (uecon dashboard), SUP-914 (customer report about high per-token costs).
